# ankra_host_targets (Data Source)

Lists the hosts registered as deploy targets in the provider's project, revoked ones included. The counterpart of `ankra targets list` and `ankra targets get`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_host_targets" "edge" {
  environment = "edge"
}

output "online_hosts" {
  value = [for target in data.ankra_host_targets.edge.host_targets : target.name if target.status == "online"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Only list targets in this environment. The platform answers an error for an environment that does not exist.

### Read-Only

- `host_targets` (Attributes List) Host targets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--host_targets))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `truncated` (Boolean) Whether the platform stopped the listing at its row cap.

<a id="nestedatt--host_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `host_targets`

Read-Only:

- `agent_version` (String) Agent version the host reported.
- `arch` (String) Architecture the host reported.
- `environment` (String) Environment name.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment identifier.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname the host reported.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the host target.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels deploy stages select targets by.
- `last_heartbeat_at` (String) Last heartbeat.
- `name` (String) Name, unique in its environment.
- `os` (String) Operating system the host reported.
- `registered_at` (String) When the host registered.
- `revoked_at` (String) When the target was revoked; null while active.
- `status` (String) `online`, `offline`, or `unknown` for a host that never checked in.
